title: Product closure requires a complete clean link

provenance.observation: A cold pinned VC7.1 build compiled all 88 production translation units across two canonical profiles and linked a verified PE32 i386 Windows GUI executable with zero unresolved symbols and without force-link escape hatches. The same checkpoint retained 696 accepted exact functions out of 697 source-present functions, demonstrating that product closure and function exactness remain independent claims.
